name: OSR2+ Open Stroker
summary: Multi-axis DIY/boutique robotic stroker platform adding pitch, roll, and twist motion to standard linear VR scripts via Intiface.
ranking_rationale: True multi-axis 3DOF/6DOF motion far beyond single-axis strokers; weighed against requires diy assembly or buying from community builders.

pricing.notes: Pricing and promos change frequently; verify directly at official checkout.

pros: True multi-axis 3DOF/6DOF motion far beyond single-axis strokers
Open hardware & community scripts work seamlessly with DeoVR/VaM
Whisper-smooth brushless or servo variants from builders
cons: Requires DIY assembly or buying from community builders
Clunky desk clamp setup and software configuration
